evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Missing — no framing of 10–15 minute timeframe or promise of dependable quote, no wait for confirmation before proceeding. Rep jumps directly into availability.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Customer volunteers concerns (fragile glass chest, many books) but rep never asks 'what are your biggest concerns about this move?' — rep simply acknowledges what customer mentions.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — customer mentioned fragile glass chest and books, but rep said 'Okay' and 'Mm-hmm' without follow-up probing (no 'tell me more about that').
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — no summary reflection. Rep acknowledged concerns but did not say 'So what I'm hearing is...' format.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Partial. Covered: box count (55), floor/stories (unit 6308, third floor, no elevator), walking distance (100 ft apartment to stairs, 20 ft stairs to parking). Missing: property type (apartment assumed but not confirmed), number of rooms, additional stops. Some detail but clear gaps.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked — no mention of packing boxes for customer.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes — 'how many boxes do you have right now?' Customer estimated 40–50 small, 4–5 medium.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full — rep gave typical range ('two and a half, three and a half hours...four to five hour mark') personalized to stairs/walk distance and provided total estimate: '$1,185 including the travel fee.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full — disclosed hourly rate ($111/mover, $222 for two), travel fee ($75), trip fee, truck taxes, insurance, credit card fees all included, 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increment billing, no stairs charge.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked — rep never said 'does that feel fair?' No pause offered for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full — 'our on time guarantee if we run late we provide discounts for you' (discount framing clear).
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Partial — mentioned '$2,000 coverage for any accidental damages' and 'no worries damage coverage' but did not explicitly state 'no deductible/no fine print' or that it's 'built into the rate, not an add-on.' Rep did say 'all of that is already in the price' for some features but did not specifically anchor damage coverage to the rate.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No — rep did not ask a version of 'Does that put those to rest?' after two promises. Moved directly to time confirmation.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked — rep jumped to 'thank you so much anything else?' which is a throwaway empty-out, not 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No — no version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never — rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' or similar. Instead, rep assumed booking: 'we will be seeing you guys this Friday' and moved straight to confirmation.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: False — no mention of rate-lock or guarantee against price changes.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial — confirmed date (Friday, October 2nd), time window (8:30–9:00 AM), email address, box/inventory count. Missing: phone number confirmation, arrival window precision (said 'between 8:30–9:00 AM' but not fully locked), crew size not stated, full address not confirmed in call (customer's and destination), no notes left for crew about fragile glass chest concern.

top_strength: Joanna gathered detailed logistics (box count, floor/stairs, walking distance) and delivered a personalized, anchored estimate ($1,185, 4–5 hours) with full pricing transparency (hourly rate, travel fee, minimums, increments, inclusions).
coaching_note: Never ask the customer for the business — rep assumed the booking instead of saying 'Would you like our help with your move?' and failed to hold silence after the estimate; also skip Section 2's agenda question entirely and jump straight into probing, losing a critical check for unstated concerns.
